title: Chemical extraction of sulfachloropyridazine from feather samples
author: Ekaterina Pokrant
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pr4dm8w
materials: Condition Aromatic sulfonic acid (Bakerbond spe™) disposable extraction columns with 6 mL of hexane and 6 mL of ethyl acetate. BAKERBOND spe™ Aromatic Sulfonic Acid (C6H5SO3H) Disposable Extraction Columns J.T. Baker Catalog #7090-29 Ethyl Acetate J.T. Baker Catalog #9280-03 n-Hexane Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #1037014000
Methanol J.T. Baker Catalog #9093-03 Water Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #1153334000

steps.title: Weigh feather sample
steps.instruction: Weigh 2 ± 0.02 g of feather sample into a 50 mL polypropylene tube.

steps.title: Add internal standard and controls
steps.instruction: Fortify each sample with the internal standard solution Sulfamethazine-(phenyl‑13C6) hemihydrate (SMZ‑13C6) and fortify the positive controls with the analyte Sulfamethazine.

steps.title: Filter supernatant through glass wool
steps.instruction: Filter the supernatant through glass wool using a 10 mL syringe, then transfer the filtrate to a fresh 50 mL polypropylene tube.

substeps.instruction: Pass the supernatant through glass wool with a 10 mL syringe.
Collect the filtrate in a new 50 mL polypropylene tube.

steps.title: Concentrate to 15 mL
steps.instruction: Concentrate the collected filtrate down to 15 mL in a water bath set to 40–50 °C while applying a mild nitrogen flow.

steps.title: Filter through columns
steps.instruction: Pass the concentrated sample through the appropriate chromatography columns.

steps.title: Centrifuge reconstituted solution
steps.instruction: Transfer the reconstituted solution into an Eppendorf tube and centrifuge at 17 000 g for 10 minutes (00:10:00).

substeps.instruction: Transfer the solution to an Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Filter through 0.22 µm PVDF filter
steps.instruction: Filter the sample through a 13 mm Millex filter with a 0.22 µm PVDF membrane and transfer the filtrate into glass vials.

substeps.instruction: Pass the sample through a 13 mm Millex 0.22 µm PVDF filter.
Collect the filtrate in glass vials.

steps.title: Final evaporation
steps.instruction: Evaporate the samples using a water bath at 40–50 °C under a mild nitrogen flow.
